```{r}
numbers <- c(10, 20, 30, 40, 50)
print(numbers)

print(numbers[1])
print(numbers[2:4])

numbers[3] <- 100
print(numbers)

numbers <- c(numbers, 60)
print(numbers)

print(length(numbers))
print(sum(numbers))
print(mean(numbers))
print(max(numbers))
print(min(numbers))

print(sort(numbers))
print(rev(numbers))

a <- c(10, 20, 30)
b <- c(1, 2, 3)

print(a + b)
print(a - b)
print(a * b)
print(a / b)

print(numbers > 30)
print(numbers[numbers > 30])
```
```{r}
mat <- matrix(c(1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8,9), nrow=3, ncol=3)

print(mat)

print(mat[1,2])

print(mat[2,])

print(mat[,3])

print(mat + 10)

print(mat * 2)

```
